creatures._stat_note: Searched, not invented. Speed 8 rather than 12: a slow Front enemy is what opens The Ridge to more than one party — see design/openness in second_encounter.md. Fictionally a moth that bumbles toward light and is disappointed reads better slow than fast anyway.
Speed 16, the fastest thing in the roster: it performs being out of reach, and mechanically it is what keeps the fight sharp while its slow partner keeps it open.
